# Energeia — Cyprus Energy News & Market Intelligence

> Energeia (https://www.energeia.cy) is the central clean energy news portal, regulatory policy intelligence platform, and verified industry directory for Cyprus. Operated by M3J2 LTD (HE 438859).

Energeia monitors regulatory developments from the Cyprus Energy Regulatory Authority (CERA), grid telemetry and market operations by the Transmission System Operator Cyprus (TSOC), renewable energy (solar PV and battery storage) grant schemes, and Eastern Mediterranean offshore energy updates.

## Core Sections

- [Home & Energy News Feed](https://www.energeia.cy/): Real-time Cyprus energy news, renewable energy updates, grid analytics, and policy coverage.
- [Helios Eye — Cyprus Energy Terminal](https://www.energeia.cy/terminal): Interactive 3D GIS platform monitoring 520+ power plants, transmission substations, and live ENTSO-E market telemetry.
- [Cyprus Energy News Updates](https://www.energeia.cy/news): Latest regulatory announcements, solar photovoltaics market reports, and electricity market updates.
- [Energy Articles & Insights](https://www.energeia.cy/articles): In-depth editorial analysis, CERA regulatory reviews, and Cyprus energy transition market reports.
- [Cyprus Energy Directory](https://www.energeia.cy/directory): Verified directory of Cyprus energy companies, solar EPC contractors, RES installers, and ESG consultants.
- [Clean Energy Academy](https://www.energeia.cy/academy): Professional courses and training programs for the Cyprus energy transition and renewables sector.
- [Energeia Magazine](https://www.energeia.cy/magazine): Print and digital energy market digests, interviews, and special reports.
- [About Energeia](https://www.energeia.cy/about): Mission, platform overview, and Cyprus energy ecosystem coverage.
